method: Built-in image_gen; original inner-frame artwork tailored to the approved outer frame.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original ornate INNER FRAME for a medieval manuscript-style music homepage. Four magnificent individually drawn corner flourishes, joined by delicate red-and-gold hairline rules, designed to nest INSIDE the newly approved outer frame in reference 1.

Reference 1 is the newly approved OUTER FRAME. Use it for palette, botanical vocabulary and visual compatibility only: warm ochre gold, deep cobalt blue, brick crimson, olive foliage, small cream flowers, blue blossoms, red berries, fine sepia contours. Do NOT reproduce that outer frame or its solid gold bands.
Reference 2 is an OLD inner corner, provided only to explain its purpose and the broad illuminated-manuscript character. Create completely new artwork; no copying, tracing, mirroring, rotating, or assembling the existing pieces.

Art direction: make this visibly richer, more regal and more exuberant than the old corner. Sumptuous but elegant manuscript illumination. Each corner is an intricate, confidently drawn botanical flourish: several broad layered scalloped acanthus leaves with deep rolled curls and warm gilt undersides, gold stems spiraling through the foliage, small beautifully drawn cream or blue flowers nestled at the joints, olive ivy and a few red berry clusters, fine tapering tendrils and delicate ivory leaf veins. Gold is prominent as painted gilding, with tiny rubbed flecks, not glossy 3D metal. Use a lively mixture of broad bold leaf shapes and fine filigree. Give the flourishes graceful diagonals and a sense of growth along both adjoining edges. Surprise with elegant intertwining and lush curled leaves, not unrelated objects.

Composition: ONE complete landscape inner frame, about 5:4 aspect ratio, centered, entirely visible. Four corner bouquets each occupy roughly the outer 23% of the width and 27% of the height, with long graceful tapering foliate extensions along the adjoining edges. The ornament projects inward from the corner and follows both adjacent margins. Each bouquet should be roughly equally substantial. Upper corners face down-and-in; lower corners face up-and-in. Between the bouquets, join their stems with exceptionally slender continuous red and gold rules, with occasional restrained leaf-like finials. Keep most of the middle of each edge visually quiet. A huge entirely transparent open central field must remain for a portrait and title; nothing crosses the middle. No central crest or hanging ornament. The thin connecting rules are supporting structure, not another thick border. Transparent outside, inside and between every leaf and stem. No solid background or rectangular gold bands anywhere.

Asymmetry is essential: all FOUR corners are independently invented botanical drawings. They belong to the same family and balance each other, but different leaf silhouettes, coiling directions, flower placements and red/blue/gold distributions make each one unique. Opposite corners are NOT mirrored copies, rotated duplicates or the same motif. Natural confident hand-painted variation.

Style: flat illuminated manuscript painting, fine sepia ink contours, matte mineral pigments, subtle worn-gold texture, ivory scratched highlights. The rich cobalt, crimson and gold should harmonize with reference 1. Precise beautiful botanical drawing, legible when this inner frame surrounds a heading on a webpage. Avoid blurry watercolor, photographic plants, baroque carved metal, jewelry, gemstones, cartoon vectors, heavy shadows or modern effects.

Output only this ONE new complete ornamental inner frame, on actual transparent alpha. No outer frame, paper, logo, portrait, text, watermark, checkerboard, swatches, contact sheet or separate numbered options. Keep all tips inside a generous clear margin.
